label: EUROPA LEAGUE · PRAGUE
headline: Four from four for Bournemouth
sub: Tyler Adams (57'), Evanilson (81') and Rayan (90') turned it around after Sparta went ahead.
caption:
🍒 Bournemouth's first European season keeps getting better.

They went behind in Prague, but Tyler Adams, Evanilson and Rayan scored after the break for a 3–1 win. That's four wins from four in the Europa League and seven straight wins in all competitions.

How far can they go? 👇

label: EUROPA LEAGUE · SELHURST PARK
headline: Kamada rescues 10-man Palace
sub: Prass scored for Hoffenheim on 7'. Wharton was sent off on 77'. Kamada levelled in stoppage time.
caption:
😮‍💨 Late drama at Selhurst Park.

Down to 10 men after Adam Wharton's second yellow, Crystal Palace were heading for defeat until Daichi Kamada equalised in stoppage time. It finished 1–1 with Hoffenheim.

Point gained or two dropped? 👇

label: EUROPA LEAGUE · GLASGOW
headline: Camilo Durán wins it late
sub: Besiktas led, Celtic went 2–1 up, Kökçü levelled on 85'... then Durán scored his second on 87'.
caption:
🍀 What a finish at Celtic Park.

Besiktas went ahead, Callum Osmand and Camilo Durán put Celtic 2–1 up, Orkun Kökçü made it 2–2 with five minutes left, and Durán struck again two minutes later. Celtic win 3–2.
